== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator lists the existing publications in this card family. Update membership here once, then use <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/There Is No Try (Reflections III)}}</nowiki></code> in each member article’s <code>versions</code> field. Preserve the article’s images, printed text and identifiers.

Family membership requires the same name, picture and card type. Light and Dark twins remain separate. Headings follow the article’s set and era. Where a composite and printable slip carry the same words, they share one version entry with separate format links. Do not invent printings.
